aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies relevant AI spot welding inspection rows but does not verify a valid baseline/change-factor structure.

Use AI decision, recheck method, date, and sample source as grouping keys.

Separate initial AI NG rate, PQC recheck, worker check, AI OK/WK NG, and summary outcomes.
Remove baseline/test wording unless source rows explicitly support it.
